phase: ROADMAP Stage 2B: metadata filter UI and eval coverage v1
baseline: GitHub main = fdb231888714df93b1d82288779b6be5823c2e2e (Add auditable library search panel)
implemented: Extended search_library/_chunk_search_rows with organization exact-match filtering and normalized format filtering.

Extended GET /api/library/search to pass through organization and format query parameters, while preserving source_type, region, min_authority, status, document_status, effective_only, date_from, and date_to.
Extended the Library Search/Verify panel with organization, format, date_from, date_to, and effective_only controls.
Updated searchFilters() to drop blank filters, include the new metadata filters, and let effective_only be true or false from the UI.
Added activeFilterSummary() so renderSearch and verifyClaim display the active candidate constraints before BM25/RRF ranking.
Added backend tests for organization, format, date range, region, authority, source_type, document_status, and effective_only behavior.
Added retrieval-eval test proving case-level organization/date/format filters are honored.
Added HTTP test proving /api/library/search accepts organization/date/format filters and excludes non-matching documents.
Extended frontend static tests for the new filter control ids and active filter summary wiring.
Updated README, ROADMAP, and RETRIEVAL_EVALUATION docs with the supported filter set and filter-before-ranking semantics.
not_implemented: The real anonymized 50-100 case retrieval/claim verification suite is still not built because no real anonymized task data was provided.
BM25 thresholds are not recalibrated on real data.
Vector retrieval, embeddings, reranking, semantic entailment, and conflict detection remain pending.
Full browser/accessibility regression tests for all form labels remain pending.

The initial Codex-added eval filter test failed once because duplicate document content triggered SHA256 dedupe; Codex fixed the fixture so both documents are unique while matching the same query, then reran the failing test and full gates successfully. dependencies: Backend and tests remain Python standard library only.
Frontend remains native HTML/CSS/JS with no npm, CDN, or external assets.
review_notes: Claude completed the initial backend/frontend filter implementation but stalled before tests/docs/report. Codex took over to add the missing test coverage, docs, and final handoff.
Filters are applied in SQL before lexical/ngram/BM25 scoring, so ranking cannot resurrect excluded candidates.
effective_only=false means the effective-only constraints are omitted; callers can combine this with document_status/status for explicit historical or prohibited evidence audits.
format is normalized with lowercase and leading-dot removal to match stored import format values.
risks: organization and region are exact-match filters; aliases, whitespace variants, and administrative synonyms are not resolved.
date filtering is string-based ISO date comparison and expects YYYY-MM-DD-like publish_date values.
format covers stored import format, not legal document genre taxonomy; full document-type taxonomy remains future work.
